action.action-desc: Mr. Carey introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Ways and Means

form.official-title: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to modernize rules related to publicly traded partnerships, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Advancing Capital for Critical Energy Supply and Security Act or the ACCESS Act.

section.header: Modernization of rules related to publicly traded partnerships

subsection.header: Exclusion of certain publicly traded classes of units from unrelated business taxable income
subsection.text: Section 512(b) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended by adding at the end the following new paragraph:

paragraph.header: Treatment of publicly traded classes of units of publicly traded partnerships
paragraph.text: There shall be excluded any income, gain, deduction, loss, or credit attributable to publicly traded classes of units of a publicly traded partnership (as defined in section 7704(b)) which is not treated as a corporation under section 7704(c), provided that the beneficial owner of such publicly traded classes of units owns (or is considered as owning within the meaning of section 318) less than 5 percent of the capital or profits of such publicly traded partnership.

subsection.header: Modification of 25 percent asset test for regulated investment companies
subsection.text: Section 851(b)(3)(B) of such Code is amended—

paragraph.text: in clause (i), by adding or at the end,
in clause (ii), by striking , or at the end and inserting a period, and

subsection.header: Elimination of separate application of passive activity rules in case of publicly traded partnerships
subsection.text: Section 469 of such Code is amended by striking subsection (k) and by redesignating subsection (l) as subsection (k).

subsection.header: Certain interests in publicly traded partnerships not treated as effectively connected income

paragraph.text: Section 864(c)(8) of such Code is amended by redesignating subparagraphs (C) through (E) as subparagraphs (D) through (F), respectively, and by inserting after subparagraph (B) the following new subparagraph:

subparagraph.header: Exception for certain interests in publicly traded partnerships
subparagraph.text: Subparagraph (A) shall not apply in the case of a partner’s sale or exchange of a class of partnership interest which is regularly traded on an established securities exchange, but only if at all times during the 5-year period ending on the date of such sale or exchange, the partner held not more than 10 percent of such class.

paragraph.text: Section 1446(f)(1) of such Code is amended by inserting , other than a class of partnership interest which is regularly traded on an established securities exchange, after interest in a partnership.

subsection.text: The amendments made by this section shall apply to taxable years beginning after December 31, 2026.
